title: Foreground/background change mid-connection: STATE{fg, pingMs}
description: The client tells the daemon its ping interval (15 s foreground, 60 s background, 5 s with an active term SUB). The daemon never pings on its own and closes a connection only after 3 x pingMs (min 45 s) without any frame. The client declares the connection dead after 2 x pingMs + 5 s without any frame RECEIVED, counted from the last received frame, not from its own last send.
framing: every frame: u32be len | u8 type | u8 flags | u16be hlen | header JSON | blob; each (conn, dir) stream starts with the 8-byte magic
